choice: each service test enters try before its first profile or start call; recorded-pid kills and reap_home run in a nested finally after stop
why: round-1 REVISE: a failed assertion before try, or a stop that timed out, skipped the kills

decision: reap_home kills by HOME, not by pidfile
choice: kill every process whose HOME is the test home, TERM then KILL, until none is left
why: an ensure loop still starting has no pidfile yet; test_service_cleanup leaked it with pidfile-only reaping

decision: guard: stand-in home instead of the real live dir (ac-3)
choice: the child pytest gets HOME=<tmp>/home with ORCH_STATE_DIR, ORCH_DB, ORCH_WAITER_DRAIN at its live dir; every file under that home must be byte-identical
why: the real live dir is rewritten by other box processes, so a strict compare there flakes; nothing in deploy/ or the guarded tests names the home except through HOME or env

choice: run the child under tests/subreaper.py (PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER); any descendant alive 5s after pytest exits is a stray, whatever its HOME
why: round-1 REVISE: HOME and state filters missed a _supervise with the real HOME; ancestry is owned before the process exits

decision: subreaper reaps orphans while the run goes
choice: waitpid(-1) loop until the command exits
why: without it, orphans stay zombies and the scripts' kill -0 sees them alive; three waiter and deploy tests failed that way

choice: pop ORCH_/FACTORY_/LINEAR_WEBHOOK_/XDG_ names in pytest_configure, restore in pytest_unconfigure
why: comment-sicko flagged the _a_ fixture-name ordering; configure runs before any fixture and before collection
